architecture.system: Native operator/harness → approved product input boundaries → module usecases/domain → Ports ← native adapters; M08 observes read-only evidence.
architecture.dependency: M01–M07 runtime plus IO native capability + locked artifact → M08 integration acceptance. No ownership of module business state.
architecture.mutation: Only future run-owned disposable fixtures through approved product operations. No current launch/build/package/install/native mutation in this delivery.
architecture.transaction: Bind source+spec+artifact+environment → verify fixture ownership → run → record actual outcome → hash comparison → retain diagnostics → cleanup only owned disposable scope.

historical binary used as current phase1 artifact

artifact.actual_path: String or null if NOT RUN
artifact.built_executable_sha256: 64hex or null; exact binary hash claimed by manifest

fixture.original_source_hashes_before_after: object keyed by fixture-local relative ID; not credentials/user documents

result.verdict: PASS | FAIL | BLOCKED | NOT RUN | PARTIAL

fields.illustrative_only: bool; true samples never count as runtime evidence

record_fields.authority: M08 evidence/harness proposal only, no product API/state/schema changed

rules.rule: PASS requires EXECUTED, assertions_executed=true, fixture_health_confirmed=true, unmet_prerequisites empty and reason explains actual observed outcome.
Win11 required case PASS needs actual Windows11 x64; Windows10/native probe cannot substitute.
E3/E4 PASS needs ELIGIBLE artifact, actual binary SHA=build manifest executable SHA, exact source inventory and approved spec/build record.

NOT RUN/BLOCKED needs no invented PID/result/capture; blocked missing prerequisites preserved. An attempted launch failing runtime startup is FAIL only after prerequisites were actually met, otherwise BLOCKED.
Capture must bind same run_id/PID/start/executable hash; screenshot alone is not executable/module proof.

Every root must have resolved absolute sandbox ownership proof before permission changes, interruption, offline volume or cleanup. Prefix text alone is insufficient; no destructive action on real user data.
Recovery cases use separate disposable test account/profile; do not assume an unimplemented test-data-dir override or change real LOCALAPPDATA.
Kill/fault tests terminate only exact run-owned PID with start-time/path/hash binding, never name-matched process or reused PID.
Artifact bytes/hash are locked before and after launch/move; source projects/materials compared before/after. Historical hash equality only validates identification, not eligibility.
Illustrative records and lower evidence layers may validate schema but never establish native/system PASS.
M08 aggregates read-only evidence, does not alter other modules/contracts/board zones or approve release.
Source/OS/artifact drift invalidates affected previous run; no stale hash substitution, automatic reclassification or NOT RUN→PASS.
